qa_pair.question: Inspect initialize and every tool schema. A fixed-URL connector cannot set Authorization. Which optional argument works across all account-scoped tools? Return its exact name.
Compare enrollment, polling, and reconnection instructions. Which one tool restores an existing account from a saved credential and enables subsequent credential-free calls within that session?
Use the workflow instructions and the payment/saving schemas to calculate the USDC cents left from the stated budget after one payment and one saving action. Return the integer.
Compare the refusal protocol with the payment description. After confirmed expiry, should an agent submit the same payment using a fresh key? Answer Yes or No.
Compare the owner approval tool with the discovery list. Can possessing a bound MCP session approve a pending budget without the owner? Answer Yes or No.
Inspect account and approval tool descriptions. Which result field carries the link that may be shown to the human without revealing an account credential?
Compare all schemas and authentication instructions. How many exposed tools accept the optional account credential argument? Return the integer.
Compare the enrollment token lifecycle and existing-account read description. Does reconnecting with a saved credential return a replacement account token? Answer Yes or No.
Combine the authentication and payment instructions: does successful session binding itself remove the need for a valid spending mandate? Answer Yes or No.
After a confirmed expiry refusal, which tool provides the current account's readable decisions and proofs without requiring an active budget? Return the exact tool name.
